scripts.test:coverage: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 exec vitest run --passWithNoTests --coverage && pnpm --filter @cadabracraft/desktop test:e2e:coverage && pnpm coverage:report
scripts.test:coverage:rust: pnpm --filter @cadabracraft/desktop exec cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --lcov --output-path src-tauri/target/llvm-cov.lcov --ignore-filename-regex 'src/main.rs' && pnpm --filter @cadabracraft/desktop exec cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml report --json --output-path src-tauri/target/llvm-cov-summary.json --ignore-filename-regex 'src/main.rs' && pnpm coverage:report:rust
